```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
monona <- read_csv("../../data/lake-monona-winters-2024.csv")
```

```{r}
model = lm(duration~year1, monona)
summary(model)
```

```{r}
# 95% Confidence interval for the slope

pe = -0.22298 
cv = qt(0.975, 169-2)
cv
se = 0.02667 

pe + c(-1, 1)*cv*se # ci of beta_hat
```

```{r}
t = pe/se
t
p_val = pt(t, 169-2)
p_val

p_val = pt(t, 169-2, lower.tail = F)
p_val
```

```{r}
predict(lm(duration~year1, monona), newdata = tibble(year1 = 2024:2030), interval = "prediction")
```

```{r}
predict(lm(duration~year1, monona), newdata = tibble(year1 = 2024:2030), interval = "confidence")
```
